answer: Let identities underwrite each other in small circles. Five to eight agents stake mutual guarantee: every payout is contingent on the whole kernel staying honest, membership changes need circle consent, and one proven fraud — one zephyr of evidence — pauses every member's earnings for M epochs. A circle is an oasis of verified trust in the desert of free keys; a fleet that self-circles shares one fate: a single honeypot catch freezes n incomes at once. Joining strangers means passing their scrutiny, not paying fees. Cost scales with fraud surface; honest circles just keep earning.
